controls.name: phase1-not-committed
controls.classification: effect: a failed load leaves its node rows uncommitted (no per-batch commit)

controls.name: rerun-completes-stranded
controls.replace: pub open spec fn is_new(db0:Db,c:Call,n:Node)->bool {!exists_in(db0,c.graph,n) || (db0[(c.graph,n)].labels.len()==0 && db0[(c.graph,n)].props.len()==0)}
controls.classification: decision: the re-run also processes nodes that have no labels or properties (the repair proposal)

controls.name: skip-sees-indexed-only
controls.replace: pub open spec fn exists_in(db:Db,g:Graph,n:Node)->bool {db.contains_key((g,n)) && db[(g,n)].node_ix}
controls.classification: decision: the skip scan without the %NOINDEX hint misses unindexed rows

controls.name: skip-across-graphs
controls.replace: pub open spec fn exists_in(db:Db,g:Graph,n:Node)->bool {exists|h:Graph| db.contains_key((h,n))}
controls.classification: decision: the skip scan is not scoped to the loader's graph

controls.name: reader-ignores-index
controls.find: pub open spec fn visible(db:Db,g:Graph,n:Node)->bool {db.contains_key((g,n)) && db[(g,n)].node_ix}
controls.classification: reader: an index read that also sees %NOINDEX rows

controls.name: rebuild-skips-labels
controls.classification: effect: rebuild_all_indices leaves the label index unbuilt

controls.name: rebuild-follows-schema
controls.find: pub open spec fn rebuild_as_built(db:Db,ns_is_graph_kg:bool)->Db {if ns_is_graph_kg {rebuild(db)} else {db}}
controls.classification: decision: the rebuild names the loader's own schema classes (the repair for bug-plt-012)

controls.name: default-schema-follows-namespace
controls.find: pub open spec fn load_in(db0:Db,c:Call,inp:Input,tables_exist:bool)->Db {if tables_exist {load(db0,c,inp)} else {db0}}
controls.classification: decision: the loader takes the namespace's recorded IVG Schema (the owner's statement)
